name: agy-engineering-cloud
displayName: AGY Engineering — Refactoring, Cloud Run & BigQuery
description: Stage-gated legacy application refactoring (adapted from Google's migrate-to-rust Crucible), zero-Docker Cloud Run source deployments, BigQuery SQL migration & cost optimization, and on-demand Google Cloud skill loading.
suggestedPrompts: Run /modernize-refactor on this legacy application to build a 6-section modernization blueprint and verify A/B output parity
Run /deploy-cloudrun to prepare and deploy this service to Cloud Run from source with a least-privilege service account and Secret Manager
Run /bigquery-architect to translate this legacy SQL query to BigQuery Standard SQL with dry-run cost caps and partitioning
